gloss: above ground, on the surface, the ground

definitions.gloss: above ground, on the surface, ground level
definitions.explanation: The surface of the earth or the area above it, as opposed to underground or in the air. Used in both everyday and technical contexts to specify location relative to the ground.

examples.japanese: {地上|ちじょう}{三階|さんがい}に{受付|うけつけ}がある。
examples.english: The reception desk is on the third floor above ground.

examples.japanese: ロケットが{地上|ちじょう}から{打|う}ち{上|あ}げられた。
examples.english: The rocket was launched from the ground.

examples.japanese: {地上|ちじょう}デジタル{放送|ほうそう}に{切|き}り{替|か}わってから、{画質|がしつ}が{良|よ}くなった。
examples.english: Since the switch to digital terrestrial broadcasting, the picture quality has improved.

notes:
USAGE:
In building descriptions, {地上|ちじょう} specifies floors above ground as opposed to {地下|ちか} (underground/basement). For example, {地上|ちじょう}{五階|ごかい}{地下|ちか}{二階|にかい} means "5 floors above ground, 2 basement floors." Also used in broadcasting: {地上|ちじょう}デジタル (terrestrial digital), commonly abbreviated to {地|ち}デジ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地上|ちじょう}～{階|かい}: ~ floor(s) above ground
- {地上|ちじょう}デジタル: terrestrial digital (broadcasting)
- {地上|ちじょう}{波|は}: terrestrial wave/broadcast
- {地上|ちじょう}から: from the ground
- {地上|ちじょう}に{出|で}る: come above ground

SIMILAR WORDS:
The opposite is {地下|ちか} (underground). {地面|じめん} (the ground surface) refers to the physical surface you walk on. {陸上|りくじょう} (on land) contrasts with water or sea.
